deckTitle: MedKayfab Synthesis Scenarios: The Grand Rumble

cards.power: Heart-Fail-the-Flood. The pump weakens, the fluid rises.
cards.lore: Find the Temporal-Phase. Listen for bibasilar crackles and +4cm JVD.
cards.gradeReason: 'Find the Temporal-Phase' is an immediate performative action — exam posture locked.
cards.artworkPrompt: Steampunk bear in flooding machinery. Style: watercolor chaos. Subject: rusted pump exploding with waves. Mood: urgent.

cards.power: Lethal-Reggie's Pressure-Slam. Immediate heart-rate and pressure drop required.
cards.lore: Sudden tearing pain + widened mediastinum. Asymmetric pulses are the tell.
cards.gradeReason: 'Asymmetric pulses are the tell' — student immediately knows what to check.
cards.artworkPrompt: Giant red aorta pipe tearing apart explosively. Style: comic gore. Subject: pipe shreds mid-section. Mood: explosive catastrophe.

cards.power: Rhythm-Rebel Chaos. Narrow complex, zero P-waves.
cards.lore: Clot-Prevention is your priority. The chaotic quiver breeds emboli.
cards.gradeReason: 'Clot-Prevention is your priority' — action locked, no ambiguity.
cards.artworkPrompt: Electrified hedgehog firing lightning arrows in all directions. Style: kinetic comic. Subject: chaotic electrical discharge. Mood: frantic panic.

cards.power: Back-Flow-Hammer. Rheumatic history shatters the valve door.
cards.lore: Pink-frothy-sputum means the lungs are drowning from the inside.
cards.gradeReason: 'Pink-frothy-sputum' viscerally immediate — students smell the diagnosis.
cards.artworkPrompt: Hippo holding broken shield with lungs flooding behind. Style: grotesque watercolor. Subject: valve failure with pink foam. Mood: drowning horror.

cards.power: Golden-Hour-Gabe. No-Hemorrhage-Red-Mist means the window is open.
cards.lore: Rescue Penumbra-the-Pleading before the 4.5-hour clock melts down.
cards.gradeReason: Melting clock urgency + named action window — time pressure embodied perfectly.
cards.artworkPrompt: Owl clutching brain with melting Dali clock on tree. Style: surrealist urgency. Subject: stroke penumbra with time pressure. Mood: frantic countdown.

cards.power: Slow-Bleeder Gravity. Venous tears creep up on the old guard.
cards.lore: Don't fall for the Anchor-the-Heavy bias; confusion after a fall is the Crescent until proven otherwise.
cards.gradeReason: 'Anchor-the-Heavy bias' names the cognitive trap — metacognitive performance.
cards.artworkPrompt: Blue crescent moon pressing down on tortoise skull with brain exposed. Style: moody atmospheric. Subject: subdural slow bleed. Mood: creeping dread.

cards.power: Vessel-Burst Explosion. The red mist floods the bunkers.
cards.lore: The ultimate thunderclap. Crimp the pipe and control the pressure instantly.
cards.gradeReason: 'Thunderclap' is the diagnosis in one word — every student knows to act.
cards.artworkPrompt: Ram headbutting causing skull explosion with red mist. Style: explosive comic. Subject: subarachnoid bleed from aneurysm. Mood: catastrophic impact.

cards.power: Signal-Disconnect. The wires are cut, the tone is lost.
cards.lore: Warm and dry hypotension. This is not hemorrhagic shock; it's a severed power grid.
cards.gradeReason: Good differentiator but 'severed power grid' needs context to distinguish vasodilatory from cardiogenic shock.
cards.artworkPrompt: Electric eel with severed cord in dark cave, hypotensive stats. Style: dark electric. Subject: neurogenic shock with cut wires. Mood: eerie stillness.

cards.power: Keto-the-Acid-Burn. The missing Insu-Key burns fat into acid.
cards.lore: Kussmaul-Breathing and fruity acetone breath means the body is venting the abyss.
cards.gradeReason: 'Fruity acetone breath' is smell-the-diagnosis level immediacy — G1 without question.
cards.artworkPrompt: Raccoon surfing crystal acid abyss with pH meter. Style: neon toxic watercolor. Subject: DKA metabolic catastrophe. Mood: chemical dissolution.

cards.power: Spark-Plug-Exile. The wide QRS canyon signals impending doom.
cards.lore: Calcium is your immediate Heart-Shield against the Killer K.
cards.gradeReason: 'Calcium is your immediate Heart-Shield' — treatment embodied in one sentence.
cards.artworkPrompt: Armadillo with ECG peaks as spines, lightning storm. Style: danger graphic. Subject: hyperkalemia with peaked T waves. Mood: electric threat.

cards.power: Hormone-Shortcut. The factory fails to make the mineral-glue.
cards.lore: Ambiguous genitalia plus an electrolyte emergency equals the Salt-Waster.
cards.gradeReason: Two-flag combo (genitalia + electrolytes) locks the diagnosis — no interpretation needed.
cards.artworkPrompt: Armored kitten standing in salt pile, glowing chest hole. Style: sad warrior. Subject: CAH newborn crisis. Mood: fragile but fierce.

cards.power: Glandular-Overlord Pete pulls calcium from the bone-vaults.
cards.lore: Flank pain, constipation, and a neck tumor. The stone stuns the system.
cards.gradeReason: 'Bones, stones, groans' classic triad embedded naturally — instant recall.
cards.artworkPrompt: Stone monster gorilla holding glowing calcium crystal, bones crumbling behind. Style: elemental destruction. Subject: hyperparathyroidism. Mood: crushing inevitability.

cards.power: Wall-Breach. The acid burns through, the dome fills with ghosts.
cards.lore: A board-like abdomen means call the Blade-Brigade immediately.
cards.gradeReason: 'Board-like abdomen' + 'Blade-Brigade' = surgical action, zero ambiguity.
cards.artworkPrompt: Rhino smashing through wall releasing acid ghosts, free air. Style: explosive comic. Subject: perforated peptic ulcer. Mood: violent breach.

cards.power: Slide-In-Move. The gut swallows the gut, causing screaming fits.
cards.lore: Sausage-shaped mass + red jelly. Deploy the Air-Enema-Fix.
cards.gradeReason: 'Sausage mass + red jelly' is textbook but visceral — baby crying is the embodied performance.
cards.artworkPrompt: Pink snake eating its own tail as telescope shape. Style: grotesque anatomy. Subject: intussusception bowel telescoping. Mood: screaming urgency.

cards.power: Infection-Incursion. The blocked highway breeds bile-sepsis.
cards.lore: Charcot's triad demands you unblock the Common-Bile-Highway immediately.
cards.gradeReason: Charcot's triad named explicitly — triage is the card's entire content.
cards.artworkPrompt: Badger attacking glowing green blocked bile pipe. Style: toxic infection. Subject: ascending cholangitis. Mood: septic emergency.

cards.power: Exit-Blocker. The projector causes profound alkalosis.
cards.lore: Feel for the olive-mass. Reset the fluids before fixing the muscle.
cards.gradeReason: 'Feel for the olive-mass' + 'fluids before surgery' — classic pearl delivered perfectly.
cards.artworkPrompt: Bulldog projectile vomiting with pH meter showing alkalosis. Style: gross comic. Subject: pyloric stenosis in infant. Mood: explosive but absurd.

cards.power: Subglottic-Squeeze. The steeple chokes the flow.
cards.lore: Stridor at night. Deploy Steroid-Stella to shrink the steeple.
cards.gradeReason: Seal + steeple is a two-layer mnemonic — auditory cue AND X-ray sign.
cards.artworkPrompt: Seal barking with steeple church on nose. Style: cartoon mnemonic. Subject: croup subglottic narrowing. Mood: wheezing urgency.

cards.power: Pump-Antagonist. Choler-the-Pump reverses the flow.
cards.lore: The fluid loss is lethal. ORS Refiller-Priority is your only move.
cards.gradeReason: 'ORS is your only move' — single intervention, zero decision paralysis.
cards.artworkPrompt: Elephant spraying rice-water flood from trunk. Style: infectious catastrophe. Subject: cholera massive fluid loss. Mood: unstoppable deluge.

cards.power: Capillary-Shredder. The horror liquefies the barriers.
cards.lore: Fever and bleeding from IV sites after the red-zone means immediate Lockdown.
cards.gradeReason: 'IV site bleeding after red-zone' is the containment trigger — isolation protocol embodied.
cards.artworkPrompt: Armored bat dripping blood in destroyed room. Style: horror biohazard. Subject: Ebola hemorrhagic fever. Mood: containment terror.

cards.power: RBC-Smasher. Falci-the-Killer sticks and clogs the brain pipes.
cards.lore: Ring-forms in the smear demand the Artesunate-Hammer now.
cards.gradeReason: 'Ring-forms → Artesunate now' is direct treatment chain with no intermediate steps.
cards.artworkPrompt: Monkey with brain visible full of blood cell gears and parasites. Style: medical horror. Subject: cerebral malaria. Mood: comatose emergency.

cards.power: Silent-Antagonist. Carboxy-the-Carbon-Copy is the ultimate Liar-Stat.
cards.lore: The pulse-ox lies. Flood the system with real oxygen instantly.
cards.gradeReason: 'The pulse-ox lies' is the single most critical cognitive alert in toxicology — G1 elite.
cards.artworkPrompt: Red chameleon next to 100% O2 sign in smoke-filled room. Style: deadly deception. Subject: carbon monoxide poisoning. Mood: silent killing.

cards.power: Liver-Threat. The toxic metabolite overwhelms the vault.
cards.lore: Plot the 4-hour level. If it crosses the line, launch the NAC rescue.
cards.gradeReason: 'Plot level → crosses line → NAC' is the decision algorithm in one sentence.
cards.artworkPrompt: Beaver before cracked blackboard nomogram with liver death arrow. Style: academic dread. Subject: acetaminophen toxicity. Mood: clinical calculation.

cards.power: Narrow-Window-Antagonist. Digo-the-Fox locks the heart-gears.
cards.lore: Low potassium makes it worse. Deploy the Antibody-Capture move.
cards.gradeReason: 'Low K worsens it' + 'Digibind' — the drug interaction and antidote locked together.
cards.artworkPrompt: Fox with yellow glowing eyes attacking gear-filled steampunk heart. Style: narrow-window poison. Subject: digoxin toxicity. Mood: clockwork malfunction.

cards.power: Metabolic-Mimic. The saboteur uncouples the cellular battery.
cards.lore: Metallic taste and garlic breath mean you need the Chelator-Cage.
cards.gradeReason: Garlic breath as smell-the-diagnosis trigger — immediate sensory performance.
cards.artworkPrompt: Rat saboteur charging a bull with glowing battery pack. Style: industrial poison. Subject: arsenic poisoning. Mood: slow sabotage.

cards.power: Eye-Shadow-Tumor. The RB1-Blueprint-Glitch removes the brakes.
cards.lore: A white glow in a photo means the red reflex is dead. Check the genome.
cards.gradeReason: 'White glow in photo = emergency' is a pearl parents can use — embodied at home.
cards.artworkPrompt: Kitten with one eye blazing white light, leukocoria glow. Style: hauntingly cute. Subject: retinoblastoma. Mood: beautiful danger.

cards.power: Kidney-Wrestler. It grows large but respects the borders.
cards.lore: It does NOT cross the midline. Do not touch it, or the capsule breaks.
cards.gradeReason: 'Do NOT touch it' is a prohibition-as-action — the card literally tells you what NOT to perform.
cards.artworkPrompt: Goat with giant caution-tape purple fist on flank. Style: pediatric warning. Subject: Wilms tumor capsule. Mood: careful restraint.

cards.power: Jagged-Adrenal-Monster. It defies the anatomical midline.
cards.lore: Dancing eyes and calcifications. This monster crosses the line.
cards.gradeReason: 'Dancing eyes + crosses midline' vs Wilms' do-not-cross — the contrast is the clinical pearl.
cards.artworkPrompt: Bear-spider hybrid monster from adrenal gland crossing anatomical midline. Style: neurological horror. Subject: neuroblastoma. Mood: defiant monster.

cards.power: Crowd-Out Mechanism. The blast-punks halt all normal production.
cards.lore: TDT positive bone pain means the marrow has been invaded.
cards.gradeReason: 'TDT positive bone pain' is the diagnostic pearl delivered through punk crowd imagery.
cards.artworkPrompt: Mob of punk lymphoblasts invading subway bone marrow tunnel. Style: urban invasion. Subject: ALL marrow takeover. Mood: relentless crowding.

cards.power: Filter-Inflammation. The post-strep immune complexes start a riot.
cards.lore: Puffy eyes, high BP, and RBC casts. The Nephritic-Pattern is active.
cards.gradeReason: Three-sign triad plus cast type locks nephritic vs nephrotic without a textbook.
cards.artworkPrompt: Army of rodents attacking gold kidney filter releasing dark blood. Style: military immune assault. Subject: post-strep GN. Mood: inflammatory riot.

cards.power: Filter-Hole-Syndrome. The electrical charge barrier is wiped out.
cards.lore: Massive swelling + 4+ protein = Nephrotic-Pattern. Replace the shield.
cards.gradeReason: 'Nephrotic-Pattern' trigger is immediate after massive edema + protein — two-sign lock.
cards.artworkPrompt: Pig floating in coin-leaking hammock net. Style: gentle nephrotic pathos. Subject: minimal change disease. Mood: harmless but leaking.

cards.power: Tubular-Melt. The ischemic-halt kills the lining cells.
cards.lore: When the pressure drops, the tubes die and slough off as muddy brown casts.
cards.gradeReason: Muddy brown casts = ATN is the cast-diagnosis pearl delivered in the lore itself.
cards.artworkPrompt: Pink pipes melting into brown mud in septic landscape. Style: ischemic decay. Subject: ATN tubular necrosis. Mood: collapse and slough.

cards.power: Allergic-Kidney. The drug-trigger sparks an internal allergy war.
cards.lore: Fever, rash, and eosinophils in the urine after new meds. Sto[p the drug]
cards.gradeReason: 'New meds + rash + eosinophils = stop the drug' — clinical triage in six words.
cards.artworkPrompt: Angry kidney covered in rash attacked by lightning bolts. Style: allergic inflammation. Subject: AIN from drug. Mood: immune overreaction.

cards.power: Eclampsia-Storm. The ultimate high-pressure brain overload.
cards.lore: When the seizure hits, Mag-the-Magnet is your only rescue move.
cards.gradeReason: 'Mag is your only rescue move' — single-drug treatment locked in one clause.
cards.artworkPrompt: Kangaroo seized in electric storm clutching Stay Fluffy disc. Style: obstetric emergency. Subject: eclampsia with MgSO4 shield. Mood: electric desperation.

cards.power: Gate-Blocker. Placenta-Phil covers the cervical exit entirely.
cards.lore: Painless bright red bleeding. Rule #1: NO vaginal exams ever.
cards.gradeReason: Power/lore text is Placenta Previa content in an Ectopic card — text swap error creates confusion.
cards.artworkPrompt: Fallopian tube rupturing with embryo escaping, blood spray. Style: surgical emergency. Subject: ectopic pregnancy rupture. Mood: catastrophic tube failure.

cards.power: Wrong-Arena-Invasion. The tube cannot handle the expansion.
cards.lore: Sudden RLQ pain and shock with an empty uterus. The tube is rupturing.
cards.gradeReason: Power/lore text is Ectopic content in a Placenta Previa card — text swap error creates confusion.
cards.artworkPrompt: Penguin with red flag standing in EXIT doorway soaked in bright blood. Style: placenta danger. Subject: placenta previa painless bleed. Mood: silent alarm.

cards.power: Premature-Rip. The life-support forcibly detaches early.
cards.lore: Dark blood, rock-hard uterus, and relentless pain. Hit the Emergency-Exit.
cards.gradeReason: 'Rock-hard uterus + dark blood' triad = abruption, no ambiguity, action clear.
cards.artworkPrompt: Torn placenta ripped from uterine wall, dark blood gushing. Style: obstetric gore. Subject: placental abruption. Mood: relentless pain.

cards.power: Micro-Mitch Famine. The ferritin-vault is completely empty.
cards.lore: Pale skin, spoon-nails, low MCV. The factory has no metal to build cells.
cards.gradeReason: 'Spoon-nails + low MCV' is the koilonychia pearl embedded naturally.
cards.artworkPrompt: Pale horse pulling empty O2 cart down dusty road. Style: depletion road. Subject: iron deficiency anemia. Mood: exhausted famine.

cards.power: Cobalt-Famine. Macro-Max cells form, while the nerve-insulation dies.
cards.lore: Big cells + neuropathy. Folate won't fix the melting nerves.
cards.gradeReason: 'Folate won't fix the nerves' is the critical B12 vs folate differentiator — exam pearl locked.
cards.artworkPrompt: Deer carrying giant red blood cell while nerve cables fray. Style: neurological decay. Subject: B12 deficiency with neuropathy. Mood: insidious loss.

cards.power: Vaso-Occlusive-Crisis. The mutant hemoglobin polymerizes under stress.
cards.lore: Sudden severe bone pain. Oxygen and hydration are your immediate moves.
cards.gradeReason: 'Oxygen and hydration are your immediate moves' — bedside action without prescription delay.
cards.artworkPrompt: Sickle-shaped bugs crushing red blood cells in red pipe. Style: vascular occlusion. Subject: sickle cell vaso-occlusive crisis. Mood: bone-crushing pain.

cards.power: Coagulation-Chaos. The system clots until it has nothing left but bleeding.
cards.lore: Elevated PT/aPTT, empty fibrinogen, and schistocyte-shards. The parado[x is real]
cards.gradeReason: 'Clots until nothing left but bleeding' is the DIC paradox in one devastating phrase.
cards.artworkPrompt: Rhino soldiers in explosion, empty glue barrels, shattered shields. Style: coagulation warfare. Subject: DIC clot-bleed paradox. Mood: chaotic collapse.

cards.power: Tissue-Melter. The invader liquefies the liver architecture.
cards.lore: Travel history + fever + brown paste = deploy Metro-the-Melt.
cards.gradeReason: 'Travel + fever + brown paste = Metronidazole' — three-factor triage direct.
cards.artworkPrompt: Green monsters liquefying dark liver tissue into brown paste. Style: tropical horror. Subject: amoebic liver abscess. Mood: invasive dissolution.

cards.power: Factory-Fire. The digestive enzymes activate inside the factory.
cards.lore: Boring pain to the back with high Lipase. NPO-Rest is the only way to cool the fire.
cards.gradeReason: 'NPO-Rest is the only way to cool the fire' — single intervention, no medication confusion.
cards.artworkPrompt: Dog with bomb pancreas exploding green enzymes. Style: self-destruction biology. Subject: acute pancreatitis autodigestion. Mood: internal inferno.

cards.power: Acid-Erosion. The protective layer fails, exposing the blood pipes.
cards.lore: Black stool and coffee-ground vomit means the acid has digested the blood. PPI-shutdown now.
cards.gradeReason: 'PPI-shutdown now' is the immediate intervention — ground vomit as sensory cue.
cards.artworkPrompt: Black coffee grounds erupting from stomach anatomy cross-section. Style: GI emergency. Subject: upper GI bleed melena. Mood: acid erosion horror.

cards.power: Malignant-Stenosis. The slow-growing ring chokes the exit.
cards.lore: Weight loss and pencil-thin stools. The obstruction risk is critica[l]
cards.gradeReason: 'Pencil-thin stools + apple-core' is the radiology-to-symptoms pipeline students memorize first.
cards.artworkPrompt: Monstrous apple-core creature blocking pink colon tunnel. Style: malignant stenosis. Subject: colorectal cancer apple-core sign. Mood: slow choking.

cards.power: Signal-Overload. Too much serotonin cooks the brain and jerks the muscles.
cards.lore: Fever, hyper-reflexia, and clonus. Deploy Cypro-the-Antidote to block the receptors.
cards.gradeReason: Triad named explicitly + antidote named — classic three-finder triage perfected.
cards.artworkPrompt: Screaming chimpanzee with electric brain in blue lightning storm. Style: serotonin overload. Subject: serotonin syndrome with clonus. Mood: overcooking crisis.

cards.power: Dopamine-Lockdown. The sudden dopamine block creates a rigid inferno.
cards.lore: Fever 41C + lead-pipe rigidity. Use Dantrolene-Relax to unfreeze the iron.
cards.gradeReason: 'Dantrolene to unfreeze the iron' — antidote with visual metaphor, zero ambiguity.
cards.artworkPrompt: Iron bull in flames with lead-pipe muscles frozen stiff. Style: dopamine inferno. Subject: neuroleptic malignant syndrome. Mood: rigid catastrophe.

cards.power: Energy-Deficit. Thiamine-B1-Famine kills the brain's energy production.
cards.lore: Confusion, ataxia, and eye paralysis. Jumpstart the battery with B1 before the lights go out.
cards.gradeReason: 'Jumpstart with B1 before the lights go out' — urgency + intervention in one clause.
cards.artworkPrompt: Bear wobbling in fog with EMPTY brain battery below. Style: nutritional deficit. Subject: Wernicke encephalopathy. Mood: brain lights dimming.

cards.power: Salt-Nimic-Toxicity. Lithium pretends to be salt and wrecks the filters.
cards.lore: Coarse tremors and GI upset. Fluid-Flush is required when the salt drops.
cards.gradeReason: The Na-mimicry mechanism needs explanation to connect 'low Na → more toxicity' for students.
cards.artworkPrompt: Wolf shaking with electrical sparks, broken salt crystal weights. Style: toxic tremor. Subject: lithium toxicity with Na loss. Mood: shaking system failure.

cards.power: The Signal-Block. Mag-the-Magnet has muted all nerve-and-muscle communication.
cards.lore: Reflexes disappear before breathing stops. Calcium-Gluconate is the antidote.
cards.gradeReason: 'Reflexes disappear before breathing' is the monitoring sequence + antidote locked.
cards.artworkPrompt: Kangaroo under dark blanket losing reflexes, calcium bottle nearby. Style: quiet neuromuscular. Subject: magnesium toxicity. Mood: muted silence.

cards.power: Metal-Poison. Wilson-the-Copper-King overloads the liver-vault without its carrier.
cards.lore: Tremors, jaundice, and gold rings. Trap the metal in the Penicillamine-Cage.
cards.gradeReason: 'Gold rings' for KF rings is poetic but Wilson's triad requires medical context to fully embody.
cards.artworkPrompt: Lion king vomiting copper coins with Kayser-Fleischer rings glowing in eyes. Style: regal metal toxicity. Subject: Wilson's disease. Mood: tarnished royalty.

cards.power: Heme-Hacker. The heavy metal destroys brain development and hemoglobin assembly.
cards.lore: Old houses, belly pain, and bone lines. The EDTA-Chelator must be deployed.
cards.gradeReason: Environmental context (old houses) + three signs + specific chelator — complete triage.
cards.artworkPrompt: Puppy chained with blue stipple dots, old house in background. Style: environmental toxin. Subject: lead poisoning. Mood: childhood tragedy.

cards.power: The Permanent-Stain. Argentos-Silver permanently deposits in the skin armor.
cards.lore: Harmless but irreversible. It's a permanent Cosmetic-Verdict.
cards.gradeReason: 'Do nothing' as the action is anti-climactic — the card describes rather than invites performance.
cards.artworkPrompt: Blue gorilla smiling with silver deposits in grey-blue skin. Style: permanent curiosity. Subject: argyria colloidal silver. Mood: ironic harmlessness.

cards.power: The Diagnostic Orchestrator. See the overlaps, beat the clock.
cards.lore: The patient is a story written across five decks. Solve the match before the final bell! Stay fluffy!
cards.gradeReason: Meta-card that IS the synthesis role — embody the orchestrator immediately.
cards.artworkPrompt: Yellow rabbit in lab coat juggling glowing orbs from trash can. Style: chaotic mastery. Subject: FrizzleBob synthesis maestro. Mood: joyful controlled chaos.

cards.power: Lethal Combo. Renal-Failure traps Hyper-K-the-Killer, stopping the flooded heart.
cards.lore: Push the Calcium-Shield before the spiked T-waves flatline the pump.
cards.gradeReason: Cross-system reasoning chain locked in one action — 'push Calcium first' is unambiguous.
cards.artworkPrompt: Tortoise with heart monitor showing spiked T-waves in flooded swamp. Style: synthesis emergency. Subject: HF + renal failure + hyperK. Mood: lethal convergence.

cards.power: Uro-Storm. The blocked gate breeds rapid sepsis.
cards.lore: Foley-Catheter Drainage-Priority. You can't fight the fire until you open the drain.
cards.gradeReason: 'Open the drain first' is the classic sequencing error trap — surgical wisdom locked.
cards.artworkPrompt: Burning red bulldog chained to locked gate with fever thermometer. Style: urosepsis urgency. Subject: BPH obstruction sepsis. Mood: drain-or-die.

cards.power: Treatment-Trap. The Eclampsia cure becomes a Magnesium suffocation trap.
cards.lore: No reflexes means the dose was too high. Antidote-Move: Calcium-Gluconate NOW.
cards.gradeReason: Treatment complication as the scenario — 'no reflexes = overdose = Calcium now' is the pearl.
cards.artworkPrompt: Blue frozen kangaroo buried under calcium shields. Style: iatrogenic trap. Subject: MgSO4 overdose in eclampsia. Mood: treatment becomes threat.

verdict: Grand Rumble is the best MedKayfab deck in the series — a synthesis tournament pulling 56 high-yield clinical emergencies from five predecessor decks into one definitive ring. Metaphor precision is exceptional: 'The Cherry-Red-Suffocator' encoding the pulse-ox lie earns a place in every clinical educator's hall of fame, and the three Final Quest synthesis cards (54-56) force exactly the kind of multi-system reasoning students collapse on in exams. The text-swap between cards 34 and 35 (Ectopic and Placenta Previa carrying each other's power/lore bodies) is the deck's only structural error but it's a factual one — students drilling those OB cards will get confused and remember the wrong diagnosis. Fix that swap before any classroom deployment. Table-ready: YES.
blurb: For medical students who want 56 high-yield emergency scenarios in one synthesis deck. When cardiology crashes into nephrology and obstetrics, the Grand Rumble makes real medicine stick.

coverQA.coverVisual: 5 — FrizzleBob in destroyed hospital with flying cards, mouse clinicians, Free-the-Pills protesters, and Call-Doc-Frizzle stamp — maximum chaos energy
coverQA.coverTitle: 5 — 'MedKayfab Synthesis Scenarios: The Grand Rumble' + 'When the decks collide, the real medicine begins. Stay fluffy!' — dual-register perfect
coverQA.coverVibeMatch: 5 — cover chaos perfectly mirrors the cross-deck synthesis premise
coverQA.coverOriginality: 4 — builds on established MedKayfab visual language but 'Grand Rumble' wrestling metaphor elevates the concept
coverQA.coverViral: 4 — highly shareable in medical education circles; FrizzleBob brand recognition helps
coverQA.coverNote: This cover is the strongest in the MedKayfab series. The destroyed hospital with flying cards and 'Call Doc Frizzle!' emergency stamp instantly communicates synthesis chaos. FrizzleBob holding a skull-and-crossbones clipboard is a perfect visual pun on clinical urgency. Only minor gap: the subtitle font is lighter than optimal for small-screen thumbnail legibility.

notes: Each card features a STAT block (vital signs/lab values) in addition to Power and Lore — this is a deliberate design feature establishing the clinical scenario before the metaphor. Page 10 OB/GYN section runs 4 cards in a single horizontal strip rather than the standard 2×2 grid. Page 15 contains 3 'Final Quest' synthesis scenario cards plus the FrizzleBob Synthesis meta-card. CRITICAL CONTENT ERROR: cards 34 (The Ectopic-Tube-Burst) and 35 (The Painless-Placenta-Bleed) have their Power/Lore bodies swapped — Ectopic card carries Placenta Previa clinical content and vice versa. Three cards have edge-cropped lore text: card 32, card 40, card 44. Font artifacts: 'KayfaBINGO!' and 'KayfaBONGO!' decorative text embedded in page artwork (not card content).

urgent: CONTENT SWAP FIX: Cards 34 (The Ectopic-Tube-Burst) and 35 (The Painless-Placenta-Bleed) carry each other's Power/Lore bodies — swap them before any classroom deployment or Gumroad listing.
Edge-crop fix on cards 32, 40, 44 — lore text is cut at page boundary; full sentences must be visible.
quickWins: Add RAF dice box mechanic to Final Quest synthesis cards (54-56) — multi-system complexity warrants difficulty escalation.
Consider subtitle font weight increase on cover for better thumbnail legibility at small sizes.
niceToHave: Add a 'Cross-Deck Reference' back panel showing which original MedKayfab deck each card originates from.
The Silver-Blue-Aura (card 52) would benefit from a stronger 'do not use colloidal silver' performative action hook.
